description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Restored in-game narration: libflite now bridges Android system TTS; integrated native JSound (libjsound.so → OpenAL), fixing Java Sound failures under the Forge loader.
2. Control layout editing and runtime enhancements: dual-corner handle scaling, floating action bar, control group management panel with group duplication, sliding chains, joystick dead zone and forward lock, global control opacity; the control editor was rewritten in Kotlin and aligned with the in-game menu visuals.
3. The in-game right menu was reworked into top icon tabs that show category content directly; hotbar scale moved to the gestures page, control opacity to the left menu, and lock/hide controls to the debug page.
4. Renderer version limits adjusted: dual-track version numbers for checking/display plus a 26.3 version catalog, with renderer compatibility corrected.
5. Unlocked the game frame rate from the screen refresh rate; no longer capped when vsync is off.
6. JNA natives switched to per-ABI directories pruned with the APK architecture; FCLNumberSeekBar rewritten in Kotlin with a capsule track and fixed click hotspots.
7. Fixed SRV record resolution in game, zink 26.3+ failing to fall back to Vulkan, Forge loader split package conflicts, plugin uninstall exiting immediately, crashes when switching mods kept as old versions, and possible crashes when opening the launcher with the screen off.
8. Fixed derived theme colors not following alpha, input focus being cleared unexpectedly, and installed badges in mod download lists not refreshing; narrowed the skin model waist seam.
9. Updated translations.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.恢复游戏内复述功能：libflite 桥接安卓系统 TTS；集成原生 JSound（libjsound.so → OpenAL），修复 Forge 加载器下 Java Sound 失效
2.控制布局编辑与运行时增强：双角手柄缩放、悬浮操作栏、控件组管理面板与控件组复制、滑动链、摇杆死区与前进锁、全局控件不透明度；控件编辑器重构为 Kotlin 并对齐游戏菜单视觉
3.游戏内右菜单重构为顶部图标 Tab 直接显示分类内容；物品栏缩放移入手势页、控件不透明度移入左菜单、锁定/隐藏控件移入调试页
4.渲染器版本上限调整：判断/展示双轨版本号与 26.3 版本目录，修正各渲染器版本适配情况
5.解除游戏帧率对屏幕刷新率的锁定，关闭垂直同步时不再受限
6.JNA natives 改为分架构目录并随 APK 架构裁剪打包；FCLNumberSeekBar 重构为 Kotlin，修复点击热区与显示不一致
7.修复游戏内无法解析 SRV 记录、zink 启动 26.3+ 无法回退 Vulkan、Forge 加载器 split package 冲突、插件卸载立即退出、模组更新保留旧版本切换后崩溃、熄屏打开启动器可能崩溃等问题
8.修复主题色带透明度时衍生色不跟随、输入框焦点被误清、下载模组列表已安装标记不刷新等问题；缩小皮肤模型腰部接缝间隙
9.更新多语言翻译
